name: The Ur-Dragon
oracle_text:
Eminence — As long as The Ur-Dragon is in the command zone or on the battlefield, other Dragon spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.
Flying
Whenever one or more Dragons you control attack, draw that many cards, then you may put a permanent card from your hand onto the battlefield.
blocked_sentences: Eminence — As long as The Ur-Dragon is in the command zone or on the battlefield, other Dragon spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.

needs.what: A STATIC ability that is collected and applied while its card sits in the COMMAND ZONE -- the static counterpart of the command-zone trigger walk that Edgar Markov already uses. Concretely, two pieces: (1) a `_command_zone_statics(state)` walk in src/automtg/engine/characteristics.py, built exactly like the existing `_graveyard_statics` -- iterate each player's command zone, read the PRINTED face's abilities, keep those with `is_static` and `Zone.COMMAND in ability.active_zones`, gate each through `_static_active`, and append the results to `_battlefield_statics`/`_active_statics` so that every downstream reader sees them at once: `cost_reduction.spell_cost_reduction`, the player-wide statics in `_active_player_statics`, and the characteristic layers. (2) the loader's static branch (src/automtg/cards/loader/__init__.py, the `unsupported = set(zones) - {Zone.BATTLEFIELD, Zone.GRAVEYARD}` guard at the end of the static compile) widened to admit `Zone.COMMAND` once that walk exists. "Or on the battlefield" then needs nothing extra: `active_zones: ["battlefield", "command"]` on one `spell_cost_reduction` static says the whole printed clause, because being gathered from either zone IS the "as long as" -- the same argument the Anger comment already makes for the graveyard. This one walk unblocks every Eminence card whose eminence ability is a static rather than a trigger, and it is also the blocker `_compile_emblems` names in its own docstring when it refuses emblem statics ("a static is read by several separate walks ... none of which look at the command zone"), so closing it clears two roadmap items at once.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The static effect itself is not the problem: `spell_cost_reduction` with `affects_spells: {"controller": "you", "subtypes": ["Dragon"], "exclude_self": true}` and `amount: {"const": 1}` says "other Dragon spells you cast cost {1} less to cast" exactly, and it is already shipped on Warden of Evos Isle and Watcher of the Spheres. The ZONE is the blocker. `active_zones` is the only key that could carry it and it is read on the activated and triggered branches of `_compile_printed_ability` only; the static branch re-reads it and then hard-refuses anything outside battlefield/graveyard with "a static can be active on the battlefield or in a graveyard; nothing collects one in ['command']", so `active_zones: ["battlefield", "command"]` is a load error rather than an inert card -- and even if the guard were lifted alone, `_battlefield_statics` walks `state.battlefield` and `_graveyard_statics` walks each player's graveyard, so nothing would ever collect it and the card would load clean and quietly be a battlefield-only discount. Dropping the command-zone half is not a weaker card but a different one: eminence's entire point is that the discount is live BEFORE the commander is ever cast, which for a nine-mana commander is most of the game. `card_level_cost_reduction` is the other near miss and points the wrong way -- it is "THIS spell costs {N} less", a discount on The Ur-Dragon itself, not on other Dragons. A triggered ability with `active_zones: ["battlefield", "command"]` (Edgar Markov's shape) works from the command zone but cannot express a cost reduction at all: there is no trigger event for "as you cast a spell, before its cost is locked in", and `spell_cast` fires after payment.

notes: Only the eminence line is blocked. Flying is a printed keyword, and the third line is expressible today and was verified against the shipped pool before filing: `you_attack` (once per declaration, unlike `attacks`, which is per creature) with `controller: "you"` and `condition: {"exists": {"binding": "attackers", "subtypes": ["Dragon"]}}` -- the shape Ainok Strike Leader uses -- then `draw` with `amount: {"count": {"binding": "attackers", "subtypes": ["Dragon"]}}` for "that many" (Chivalric Alliance and Champions from Beyond already count that binding), then `may` wrapping `put_onto_battlefield` over a hand selector, which the op accepts -- ninjutsu already puts a card onto the battlefield from hand. Note for whoever builds this that a `filter` on the trigger is NOT the way to say "Dragons": `you_attack` is absent from `OBJECT_SUBJECT_TRIGGERS`, so `_matches` finds no subject and returns False, and the ability would silently never fire. Deliberately not written as a partial answer: the eminence line would be left unclaimed and fail the residual gate, and a battlefield-only discount is the quiet approximation the brief forbids. In the sandbox the difference is invisible either way -- the card is cast from hand onto an empty-of-Dragons board, combat is declined so the attack trigger cannot fire, and no expectation key can observe a cost reduction -- which is exactly why this had to be triaged against the engine rather than against the harness.
